title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
summary: Meta showcased its growing lineup of smart glasses products at the company's developer conference, emphasizing wearable technology as a key platform for consumer engagement. The demonstration highlights Meta's strategic focus on connecting users to digital experiences through eyewear devices.
content: The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses.

zh.title: Meta Connect上，该公司的智能眼镜无处不在
zh.summary: Meta在公司开发者大会上展示了不断增长的智能眼镜产品线，强调可穿戴技术是消费者参与的关键平台。此次展示突出了Meta通过眼镜设备将用户连接到数字体验的战略重点。
